user_query: I'm organizing a Halsey-themed party and I want to display the album covers as decorations. Can you fetch all the albums by Halsey and their release dates? Also, provide me with a random song and its lyrics from each album. Additionally, I need the available voices for text-to-speech conversion.

TaskList.description: Fetch all albums by Halsey and their release dates.
From the fetched album list, select a random song from each album and obtain its lyrics.
Gather the available voices for text-to-speech conversion.
